pocket_clearance.method: Retain original triangle registration for moving mouth anchors. A coherent 115 by 95 mm patch grid follows its mouth tangent, raised 20 mm above the existing anchor, with a perpendicular downward axis before subdivision. After level-three pocket subdivision, project from 150 mm behind each patch point along the fixed native walk rear-to-front axis onto the first visible shorts-shell hit. Divide 2 mm clearance by the absolute ray/interpolated-normal dot product, bounded below at 0.25; smooth the clearance field over six neighboring-point iterations and offset behind the hit before thickness. Hidden pocket sewing surfaces share the pattern and projection. Scoped to this authored straight walk; no general turning/physical simulation claim. Failed normal-based and post-thickness projections are not retained.
